name: Spawnbroker — the engine refuses a Permanent B stronger than A at fire time (counters after firing do not count)
notes: Hill Giant is 3/3 when Spawnbroker's trigger is fired and gets three +1/+1 counters afterwards. B is judged on the fire-time snapshot, so Craw Wurm (6) is still not listed, and a pair set anyway (a saved board, a recipe) exchanges nothing: effectAppliesToPerm refuses a pair exchangeControlPairProblem rejects (CR 701.12b). Before, Hill Giant and Craw Wurm swapped.
